title: `teploy rollback [--to X] --json`: the machine result of a successful rollback (rev 14, token rollback-json-v1)

server.description: The servers.yml name (or host) the rollback ran against.

from.description: Release hash the app ran before the rollback (post-rollback state's previous release; may be empty for a first-deploy edge).

ok.description: Always true on this document; failures use the error envelope on stderr and never emit this shape.
